projects.title: Plant Health Monitoring System
projects.summary: A Flask application that uses a fine-tuned MobileNetV2 model to classify plant diseases from leaf images.
projects.problem: Plant disease identification needs to be fast and accessible to end users working from image data.
projects.solution: A transfer-learning model was trained with TensorFlow and Keras, then integrated into a Flask REST endpoint for real-time disease prediction.
highlights: Fine-tuned a MobileNetV2 transfer-learning model for plant disease classification
Compared CNN architectures to guide model selection and reduce experimentation time
Delivered a REST endpoint for real-time prediction from leaf images

projects.title: Smart Cafeteria Ordering System
projects.summary: A full-stack cafeteria pre-ordering platform with secure payments and a role-based content management system.
projects.problem: A cafeteria ordering workflow needs convenient online payments while keeping menu management simple for staff.
projects.solution: A React and Node.js application connected to PostgreSQL, with Stripe checkout, role-based CMS controls, and cloud deployment through Infrastructure-as-Code.
highlights: Implemented a secure Stripe API checkout workflow
Built role-based CMS interfaces for menu listings and product images
Automated deployment with render.yaml and a serverless Neon PostgreSQL database

projects.title: Portfolio Platform
projects.summary: A fast, editorial portfolio platform that combines a public experience with a purpose-built content workspace.
projects.problem: A portfolio needs to communicate creative work while still being easy to maintain as the work grows.
projects.solution: A statically generated Next.js experience is paired with a local Express admin service, structured content, image processing, and optional AI-assisted metadata workflows.
highlights: Typed content model with reusable presentation rules
Optimized image pipeline for full-size and thumbnail assets
Accessible interactions, keyboard support, and responsive layouts
